```{r}
curve_files <- list(
  usa = "usa-bs.csv",
  gbr = "gbr-bs.csv",
  jpn = "jpn-bs.csv",
  cad = "cad-bs.csv",
  ger = "ger-bs.csv",
  fra = "fra-bs.csv",
  itl = "itl-bs-ib.csv",
  aus = "aus-bs-ib.csv"
)

yields <- lapply(curve_files, function(x) {
  read.csv(here("reconstructed_data", x), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

yields <- lapply(yields, function(x) {
 x %>% dplyr::filter(as.Date(time) >= as.Date("2010-01-01") & 
                       as.Date(time) <= as.Date("2020-12-31"))
})


curves <- c("usa", "gbr", "jpn", "cad", "ger", "fra", "itl", "aus")
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360) 
mat_str <- paste0("X", unlist(lapply(mats, numeric_to_matname)))

rm(curve_files)
```

```{r}
## single curve fitting (baseline)
marginal_DNS <- lapply(yields, function(x) sc_fit(yields = x, mats = mats, type = c("nelson"), lambdas = c(0.0609), ts = FALSE))

## NS model residuals 
sc_residuals <- setNames(lapply(seq(1:length(yields)), function(x) {
  marginal_DNS[[x]][['yields']] - yields[[x]][, 2:11]
  }), curves)

## tenor ordering 
wt_list <- setNames(lapply(mat_str, function(tenor) {
  out <- do.call(cbind, lapply(curves, function(ccy) sc_residuals[[ccy]][[tenor]]))
  colnames(out) <- curves
  as.data.frame(out)
  }), paste0("wt_", mat_str))

```

```{r}
## rolling window correlation matrix construction  
build_rolling_corr_array <- function(wt_df, width = 60, min_obs = NULL,
                                     align = "right", overlap = width - 1) {
  wt_mat <- as.matrix(wt_df)
  if (is.null(min_obs)) {
    min_obs <- width
  }
  
  if (width < 2) {
    stop("Rolling window width must be at least 2.")
  }
  
  if (min_obs < 2 || min_obs > width) {
    stop("min_obs must satisfy 2 <= min_obs <= width.")
  }

  if (length(overlap) != 1 || !is.numeric(overlap) || overlap < 0 ||
      overlap >= width || overlap %% 1 != 0) {
    stop("overlap must be an integer satisfying 0 <= overlap < width.")
  }
  
  n <- nrow(wt_mat)
  corr_path <- vector("list", n)
  curve_names <- colnames(wt_mat)
  step_size <- width - overlap
  last_eval_i <- NULL
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    if (align == "right") {
      idx <- max(1, i - width + 1):i
    } else if (align == "center") {
      half_window <- floor((width - 1) / 2)
      idx <- max(1, i - half_window):min(n, i + half_window)
    } else if (align == "left") {
      idx <- i:min(n, i + width - 1)
    } else {
      stop("align must be one of 'right', 'center', or 'left'.")
    }
    
    if (length(idx) < min_obs) {
      corr_path[[i]] <- NA
    } else if (!is.null(last_eval_i) && (i - last_eval_i) < step_size) {
      corr_path[[i]] <- NA
    } else {
      corr_path[[i]] <- stats::cor(wt_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
      rownames(corr_path[[i]]) <- curve_names
      colnames(corr_path[[i]]) <- curve_names
      last_eval_i <- i
    }
  }
  
  return(corr_path)
}

## visualization formatting 
rolling_corr_long <- function(wt_df, time_index, width = 60, min_obs = NULL,
                              upper_only = TRUE, overlap = width - 1) {
  corr_path <- build_rolling_corr_array(
    wt_df = wt_df, width = width, min_obs = min_obs, overlap = overlap
  )
  
  curve_names <- colnames(wt_df)
  p <- length(curve_names)
  
  # Build pair grid in matrix-display order
  if (upper_only) {
    pair_grid <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(seq_len(p - 1), function(i) {
        data.frame(
          row = curve_names[i],
          col = curve_names[(i + 1):p],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      })
    )
  } else {
    pair_grid <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(seq_len(p), function(i) {
        data.frame(
          row = curve_names[i],
          col = curve_names,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      })
    )
  }
  
  pair_levels <- paste(pair_grid$row, pair_grid$col, sep = " / ")
  
  corr_long <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(corr_path), function(i) {
    corr_i <- corr_path[[i]]
    
    if (length(corr_i) == 1 && all(is.na(corr_i))) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    tibble::tibble(time = time_index[i], row = pair_grid$row, col = pair_grid$col,
                   correlation = purrr::map2_dbl(pair_grid$row, pair_grid$col, function(r, c) corr_i[r, c]))
  })
  
  dplyr::mutate(corr_long, pair = factor(paste(row, col, sep = " / "), levels = rev(pair_levels)))
}

plot_rolling_corr_heatmap <- function(wt_df, time_index, width = 60, min_obs = NULL,
                                      upper_only = TRUE, title = NULL,
                                      overlap = width - 1) {
  corr_long <- rolling_corr_long(
    wt_df = wt_df, time_index = time_index,
    width = width, min_obs = min_obs,
    upper_only = upper_only, overlap = overlap
  )
  
  ggplot2::ggplot(corr_long, ggplot2::aes(x = time, y = pair, fill = correlation)) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile() +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "red",
      mid = "white",
      high = "blue",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-1, 1)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Time Index",
      y = "Curve pair",
      fill = "Corr"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

plot_wt_correlations <- function(wt_list, time_index, width = 60,
                                 tenors = names(wt_list), overlap = width - 1) {
  stats::setNames(
    lapply(tenors, function(tenor_name) {
      plot_rolling_corr_heatmap(
        wt_df = wt_list[[tenor_name]],
        time_index = time_index,
        width = width,
        title = paste("Rolling cross-curve correlations:", tenor_name),
        overlap = overlap
      )
    }),
    return(tenors)
  )
}
```

```{r}
pairwise_corr_summary <- function(corr_list) {
  first_mat <- corr_list[[1]]
  pair_idx <- which(upper.tri(first_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)
  pair_names <- paste0(rownames(first_mat)[pair_idx[, 1]], "-", colnames(first_mat)[pair_idx[, 2]])
  
  pair_paths <- t(vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(pair_idx)),
    function(k) {
      i <- pair_idx[k, 1]
      j <- pair_idx[k, 2]
      vapply(corr_list, function(M) M[i, j], numeric(1))
    },
    numeric(length(corr_list))
  ))
  
  count_sign_changes <- function(x) {
    s <- sign(x)
    s <- s[s != 0]
    if (length(s) <= 1) return(0L)
    sum(s[-1] != s[-length(s)])
  }
  
  data.frame(
    pair = pair_names,
    mean_abs_corr = rowMeans(abs(pair_paths)),
    mean_corr = rowMeans(pair_paths),
    sd_corr = apply(pair_paths, 1, sd),
    max_corr = apply(pair_paths, 1, max),
    min_corr = apply(pair_paths, 1, min),
    frac_positive = rowMeans(pair_paths > 0),
    sign_changes = apply(pair_paths, 1, count_sign_changes),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

pairwise_corr_summary(rcorr10Y)
```


```{r}
## Bartlett's test 
combo_bartlett <- function(corr_array, width) {
  lapply(corr_array, function(x) psych::cortest.bartlett(x, n = width))
}

corr_list <- setNames(list(rcorr1M, rcorr3M, rcorr1Y, rcorr10Y, rcorr30Y), c("X01M", "X03M", "X01Y", "X10Y", "X30Y"))

bartlett_vals <- lapply(corr_list, function(x) combo_bartlett(x, width=60))
bartlett_p <- lapply(bartlett_vals$X30Y, function(x) x[[2]])
```
